invocation.label: Invocation name

locales.match: Each Echo's language must match one of these.

allows_purchases.about: Whether people can buy anything through the skill: in-skill purchases, subscriptions or real-world goods. Encore sells nothing.
allows_purchases.label: The skill allows purchases

contains_ads.about: Whether the skill plays, speaks or shows advertising, including promotions for other products. Encore has no advertising.
contains_ads.label: The skill contains advertising

is_child_directed.about: Whether the skill is designed for children under 13, as defined by the US Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). It's about who the skill is made for, not whether a child might use it.
is_child_directed.label: The skill is directed at children under 13

is_export_compliant.about: You confirm the skill can be imported to and exported from the United States and every other country it's available in, without a licence, and that it complies with import and export laws, including those for software that uses encryption. Encore controls media playback and uses only standard HTTPS encryption.
is_export_compliant.label: The skill is export compliant

privacy.unanswered_one: {{count}} question left to answer before deploying.
privacy.unanswered_other: {{count}} questions left to answer before deploying.

uses_personal_info.about: Whether the skill collects personal details from the people using it, such as names, email addresses, phone numbers or location. Encore doesn't ask for any of these: it sees each Echo's device ID and what was asked of it, and keeps that on your own server.
uses_personal_info.label: The skill collects personal information

deploy.succeeded: Deployed. The skill is enabled for testing on your Amazon account.

hello.alexaPlus: On Alexa+ devices, enable the skill once from the Alexa app's Alexa+ Store if “ask {{invocation}}” isn't recognised.
